questions.question: observe-tables can't read an amending decision's prose or a second table, so after OP-01's reopen 10 of its 11 findings are already answered by D50, D60, D62, D67 and D71, and every later reopen will do the same. No backlog item names this (BK-507 and BK-508 cover other misreads). File it?

options.label: File a new BK item (Recommended)
options.description: A new contributor.tooling item: the script reads each table as it stands, so a reopen's amendments come back as findings until the spec merges them. Keeps BK-507 and BK-508 as scoped.

options.label: Fold into BK-508
options.description: Add it to BK-508's diagnosis next to the unchecked row citations. One fewer item, but BK-508's entry is already near its line cap and covers a different misread.

options.label: Don't file
options.description: Leave the trace and the sidecar comment as the only record. Each later review re-derives which findings an amendment answers.
